desc: Parse input; transpose the grid according to move counts so the scanned dimension K is minimized.
Implement zero-safe incremental row-prefix/suffix DP with stacks (no modular inverses), maintaining answer via exact delta updates `ans += delta*pes[c]*vs[c]`.
Support O(1) L/R moves and batched O(K) U/D row-state changes (`run3`) with initial `pre0`/`S0` fallbacks.
Sample 1 passes end-to-end (456 → 666 → 822); Sample-2 numpy slice crash fixed, both samples PASS.
Randomized brute-force stress test of numpy path vs naive DP and vs solve_pure passed (all starts, oscillations, zeros, extreme a_i, both orientations).

Benchmark solve_np worst case (447x447, Q=200000, ~1e5 vertical moves); if >3s, reduce numpy-call overhead in the scan (preallocate/fuse/in-place), re-tune `_NUMPY_MIN`, re-verify samples + stress test.

If benchmark still TLEs after micro-opt, switch to a different reduction: zero-aware batch-inversion cumulative scan (cumprod + one `pow` + backward pass, segmenting at zero a_j) to get O(K) with ~5 numpy ops per scan, guarding against many-zero inputs.
